title: NeuReasoner: Theory-grounded Mapping of Reasoning Elicitation Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2606.29971v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A growing body of work suggests that the reasoning capabilities of large language models are largely latent in their base form, with post-training primarily amplifying rather than introducing them. However, this evidence comes mainly from mathematical and coding benchmarks, leaving the boundary conditions of that claim largely unexplored, namely which cognitive tasks can be recovered through elicitation and where that recovery fails. To investigate this, we introduce NeuReasoner, a theory-grounded elicitation instrument. At each step, an orchestrator pairs a Neuro Lens, inspired by functional specificity, with a Cognitive Lens, drawn from the Erotetic Theory of Reasoning, and integrates their outputs through internal modularization of a single model, without external tools. translated_title: NeuReasoner：基于理论的推理诱导边界映射
translated_abstract: 越来越多的研究表明，大型语言模型的推理能力在很大程度上以潜在形式存在于其基础模型中，而后训练主要是放大而非引入这些能力。然而，这一证据主要来自数学和编程基准测试，使得该论断的边界条件在很大程度上尚未被探索，即哪些认知任务可以通过诱导得到恢复，以及这种恢复在何处失效。为了研究这一问题，我们提出了 NeuReasoner，一种基于理论的诱导工具。在每一步中，一个协调器将受功能特异性启发的“神经透镜”与源自疑问推理理论的“认知透镜”配对，并通过单一模型的内部模块化来整合二者的输出，而无需借助外部工具。我们在 CogBench（一套来自认知心理学的行为任务套件）以及标准的数学和编程基准上评估 NeuReasoner，同时测量……
tldr: 提出基于理论的推理诱导框架 NeuReasoner，通过将受功能特异性启发的神经透镜与源自疑问推理理论的认知透镜配对并在单一模型内进行模块化整合，在认知心理学行为任务 CogBench 及数学编程基准上系统刻画了大语言模型推理能力可被诱导恢复的边界条件。
en_tdlr: NeuReasoner is a theory-grounded elicitation framework that pairs a Neuro Lens inspired by functional specificity with a Cognitive Lens from the Erotetic Theory of Reasoning, integrating their outputs via internal modularization of a single model to map the boundaries of which reasoning capabilities can be elicited from LLMs across cognitive psychology, mathematical, and coding benchmarks.
